title: journal team WebSocket frame (GET /v1/teams/{team_id}/stream)
description: frame_id is the event_id of the stored event the frame carries (for task_committed, the task's first queued event); frames are ordered by frame_id alone. data is the stored event as in the read replies (task_committed, task_event, control_event, executor_event) or the log entry (task_log). task_id is null for executor_event frames.
